SELECT e.asset_type, e.equipment_id, e.name, s.name AS sensor_name, s.sensor_type, f.description AS failuremode_description, f.name AS failuremode_name, f.severity
FROM equipment e
JOIN sensor s ON e.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
JOIN sensor_monitors_failuremode smf ON s.name = smf.sensor_name
JOIN failuremode f ON smf.failure_mode = f.name
WHERE e.name = 'Chiller 6'

SELECT wo.wo_id, wo.wo_description, wo.actual_finish, wo.work_priority
FROM workorder wo
JOIN equipment e ON wo.equipment_id = e.equipment_id
JOIN sensor s ON e.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
JOIN sensor_monitors_failuremode smf ON s.name = smf.sensor_name
JOIN failuremode fm ON smf.failure_mode = fm.name
WHERE e.name = 'Purge unit of chiller 6'
AND fm.description LIKE '%excess purge%'
AND wo.preventive = 1
ORDER BY wo.actual_finish DESC

SELECT ae.timestamp, ae.value
FROM anomalyevent ae
JOIN equipment e ON ae.asset_name = LOWER(e.name)
JOIN failuremode fm ON e.asset_type = fm.asset_type
JOIN sensor s ON e.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
JOIN sensor_monitors_failuremode smf ON s.name = smf.sensor_name
WHERE e.name = 'Chiller 6'
AND fm.name = 'Compressor Motor Failure'
AND s.sensor_type = 'Power Input'
ORDER BY ae.timestamp

SELECT s.name, e.event_time, e.event_type
FROM equipment eq
JOIN sensor s ON eq.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
JOIN event e ON eq.equipment_id = e.equipment_id
JOIN sensor_monitors_failuremode smf ON s.name = smf.sensor_name
JOIN failuremode fm ON smf.failure_mode = fm.name
WHERE eq.name = 'POKMAIN chiller 6' AND fm.description LIKE '%chiller trip%'
ORDER BY e.event_time

SELECT 
    strftime('%m', actual_finish) AS month, 
    COUNT(*) AS work_order_count
FROM 
    workorder
WHERE 
    equipment_name = 'CWC04013' 
    AND strftime('%Y', actual_finish) = '2017'
GROUP BY 
    month
ORDER BY 
    month

SELECT DATE(ae.start_time) AS event_date, COUNT(ae.alert_key) AS alert_count, COUNT(an.anomaly_key) AS anomaly_count
FROM alertevent ae
LEFT JOIN anomalyevent an ON ae.equipment_id = (SELECT equipment_id FROM equipment WHERE name = 'CWC04009') AND DATE(an.timestamp) = DATE(ae.start_time)
WHERE ae.equipment_id = (SELECT equipment_id FROM equipment WHERE name = 'CWC04009') AND strftime('%Y', ae.start_time) = '2021'
GROUP BY event_date

SELECT date(ae.start_time) AS event_date, 
       COUNT(ae.alert_key) AS alert_count, 
       COUNT(an.anomaly_key) AS anomaly_count
FROM alertevent ae
LEFT JOIN anomalyevent an ON ae.equipment_id = (SELECT equipment_id FROM equipment WHERE name = 'CWC04009')
WHERE ae.equipment_id = (SELECT equipment_id FROM equipment WHERE name = 'CWC04009')
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', ae.start_time) = '2020-05'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', an.timestamp) = '2020-05'
GROUP BY event_date

sql:
SELECT 
    wo.wo_id,
    wo.wo_description,
    COUNT(wo.wo_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workorder) AS percentage
FROM 
    anomalyevent ae
JOIN 
    equipment e ON ae.asset_name = e.name
JOIN 
    workorder wo ON e.equipment_id = wo.equipment_id
WHERE 
    ae.asset_name = 'CWC04009'
GROUP BY 
    wo.wo_id, wo.wo_description

SELECT wo.*
FROM workorder wo
JOIN alertevent ae ON wo.equipment_id = ae.equipment_id
JOIN anomalyevent an ON wo.equipment_name = an.asset_name
WHERE ae.rule_id = 'RUL0014'
AND ae.equipment_name = 'Chiller - Cooling Substance Delta T Low'
AND an.kpi = 'load'
AND an.value > an.upper_bound

SELECT alert_key AS event_key, end_time, equipment_id, equipment_name, rule_id, start_time, 'alert' AS event_type
FROM alertevent 
WHERE equipment_id = 'CWC04009' 
AND start_time >= '2020-06-01' 
AND end_time < '2020-07-01'
UNION
SELECT anomaly_key AS event_key, timestamp AS end_time, NULL AS equipment_id, asset_name AS equipment_name, NULL AS rule_id, timestamp AS start_time, 'anomaly' AS event_type
FROM anomalyevent 
WHERE asset_name = 'chiller 9' 
AND timestamp >= '2020-06-01' 
AND timestamp < '2020-07-01'

SELECT 
    MIN(wo.wo_id) AS bundle_id,
    GROUP_CONCAT(wo.wo_id) AS work_order_ids,
    MIN(wo.actual_finish) AS bundle_start_date,
    MAX(wo.actual_finish) AS bundle_end_date,
    COUNT(wo.wo_id) AS number_of_work_orders,
    SUM(wo.actual_labor_hours) AS total_labor_hours,
    GROUP_CONCAT(wo.wo_description) AS work_order_descriptions
FROM 
    workorder wo
WHERE 
    wo.equipment_id = 'CWC04009'
    AND wo.preventive = 0
    AND strftime('%Y', wo.actual_finish) IN ('2017', '2018', '2019')
GROUP BY 
    strftime('%Y-%W', wo.actual_finish)
HAVING 
    COUNT(wo.wo_id) >= 2

SELECT fm.name, COUNT(*) AS occurrence
FROM sensor s
JOIN sensor_monitors_failuremode smf ON s.name = smf.sensor_name
JOIN failuremode fm ON smf.failure_mode = fm.name
JOIN equipment e ON s.equipment_id = e.equipment_id
WHERE s.name = 'Liquid Refrigerant Evaporator Temperature' 
AND e.name = 'Chiller 6'
GROUP BY fm.name
ORDER BY occurrence DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.name, e.event_time, e.event_type
FROM equipment eq
JOIN sensor s ON eq.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
JOIN sensor_monitors_failuremode smf ON s.name = smf.sensor_name
JOIN failuremode fm ON smf.failure_mode = fm.name
JOIN event e ON eq.equipment_id = e.equipment_id
WHERE eq.name = 'MAIN chiller 6' AND fm.description LIKE '%chiller trip%' AND e.event_category = 'anomaly'
ORDER BY s.name, e.event_time
